items.title: Capão da Canoa (RS) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 25 #030
items.en_title: Capão da Canoa (RS) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 25 #030
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Capão da Canoa (RS) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 828,756.6; proposals close Nov 25, 14:01 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
